required_texts: 1.1 Introduction to GPU support in PyTorch
1.2 Tensors as the unit of GPU work
1.5 Moving tensors and models to the GPU
1.6 Difference between CPU computation and GPU computation
1.7 Basic management of GPU memory in PyTorch
Learn how PyTorch uses CUDA devices, how tensors and models move onto the GPU, and how to measure runtime and memory behavior without being misled by hidden transfers or asynchronous execution.
